What's included in the WordPress booking plugin

  • A booking form clients finish on their phone: service with photo, staff member, date and time (each time shows when the appointment ends), then their details.
  • Online payments and deposits through Razorpay (UPI), PayPal or Stripe, with automatic refunds when a paid booking is cancelled.
  • WhatsApp, SMS and email reminders sent from your own WhatsApp Business and Twilio accounts.
  • Two-way Google Calendar sync: bookings go into each staff member's calendar, and busy times there are blocked on the form.
  • Running the day: summary cards on the Bookings screen, a drag-and-drop calendar, approve or cancel in one click, and a page where clients reschedule or cancel themselves.
  • Your brand: colour, font and corner style for the form, branded emails, extra booking questions, extras and coupons.
  • Every new feature we release while your subscription is active. A new release every 15 days, and founding members vote on what comes next.

How the founding offer works

  1. Pick a plan above and pay by card or PayPal. The licence key arrives by email.
  2. Install the free Roohsites Appointment Booking plugin and Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro, then enter the key.
  3. Set up your services, staff and booking page. Most people take their first test booking within minutes.
  4. Your plan renews each year at the founding price, as long as you keep the subscription active.

The founding plans close as soon as 100 founding seats are taken. After that, new customers pay the regular prices on the pricing table.

Frequently asked questions

Does the founding price go up at renewal?

No. Your plan renews at the founding price for as long as the subscription stays active. If you cancel and come back later, you pay the regular price.

Do founding members get new features?

Yes. Both founding plans include every Pro feature, including the ones released after you join, for as long as the subscription is active.

Can I use the Studio plan on client websites?

Yes. Founding Studio covers three websites, yours or your clients'. You can move a licence from one site to another from your account.

What if I need more than three sites?

Founding plans stop at three sites and one founding licence per customer. For more sites, choose Business (5 sites) or Agency (unlimited) at the regular price.

Can I get a refund?

Yes. Every purchase has a 14-day money-back guarantee. Email us within 14 days and we refund in full. See the refund policy.

Can I try Roohsites Appointment Booking before buying?

Yes. The free Roohsites Appointment Booking plugin has unlimited services and staff, so you can set up your booking form first and add Pro when you are ready.
